player_prompt.intro:
Kedda d-iklan {player_id} deg wawal {num_rounds} n IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kul waṭṭa, ṣawwur iḍan s wakal n {min_guess} d {max_guess}.
Deffir nnuḍa n wakalen, anḍa iḍan (2/3)x(taṣwir n wakalen wudan),
d uɣaleɣ d ikal wu iḍan iqqaraben ɣer anḍa iṛummen waṭṭa-nni.
Irrac ɣer wakal-ik deg wawal '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ⵜⴰⵍⵖⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵓⵙⵍⵉⴳ; ⵙⵔⵙⵏ ⴰⵙⵏⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵏⵏⵓⵏ [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Talalt ɣur ad izuzzuɣ gar {min_guess} d {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Amɣid 0 yenna-yas {guess0}; Amɣid 1 yenna-yas {guess1}. S umbeɛd, adakkus ɣur: {target}.
